info.name: travel-quote-api
info.description: The **travel-quote-api** provides a set of RESTful endpoints to manage travel quotations, covering users, places, categories, providers, vehicles, coverages, prices, and quotations. Each endpoint is designed to facilitate the creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of relevant data, ensuring that users can efficiently handle all aspects of travel quotations. The API also supports filtering quotations by date range and managing their status, making it a comprehensive solution for travel-related services.

item.name: Quotations

request.description: Allows a user to create a new quotation, specifying the origin, destination, date, and number of passengers. Optionally, a coverage and price can also be associated with the quotation.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description: Enables a user to update the status of an existing quotation. The status can be changed to "reserved" or "reservation canceled," with necessary validations on coverage, price, and capacity.

This method retrieves all quotations associated with the **currently** **authenticated user**. It returns a list of quotations that the user has made, including relevant details such as origin and destination places, dates, and status. This allows users to view all their quotation history in one request.
Fetches all quotations within a specified date range, allowing users to filter quotations based on travel dates.

item.description: The **Quotations** folder contains endpoints for managing the entire lifecycle of a travel quotation within the system. Users can create new quotations, retrieve their own quotations, filter by date range, and change the status of their quotations to reflect reservations or cancellations.
